description: Search state-licensed daycares in the California cities Kyds Activities serves, one city at a time (`city` slug, defaults to Lodi). Filters: child age in months, program kind (daycare, preschool, after_school), setting (in_home or center), and owner-verified listings only. Returns up to 10 daycares with license type, hours and tuition where known. Subsidy, bilingual and curriculum details are in each daycare's full record.

age_months.description: Child age in months. Returns daycares whose license allows this age (infant centers and family child care homes for babies, child care centers for about 2 to 6, school-age centers from kindergarten), narrowed by the daycare's own stated ages when it has them.

city.description: City slug to search in, such as 'lodi', 'galt' or 'elk-grove'. Defaults to Lodi.

claimed_only.description: If true, only return daycares whose owner has claimed the listing (more accurate data + reliable contact channel).

setting.description: Filter by facility setting. 'in_home' is a family child care home (smaller, residential). 'center' is a commercial facility.

name: search_daycares
title: Search daycares
